definitions.explanation: Existing in or produced by nature; not artificial or man-made.
A person who is naturally scatterbrained or innocently oblivious.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{天然|てんねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{湧|わ}き{水|みず}→湧き水：18173_wakimizu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This water is natural spring water.

examples.japanese: {天然|てんねん}⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{天然|てんねん}⟦だから→だから：00924_dakara⟧、⟦{悪気|わるぎ}→悪気：28204_warugi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧よ。
examples.english: She's just naturally airheaded, she doesn't mean any harm.

examples.japanese: {天然|てんねん}⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦エネルギー→エネルギー：03834_enerugii⟧⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Natural gas is an important energy resource.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{天然|てんねん}⟦ボケ→ボケ：08822_boke⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{笑|わら}わせる→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: He's a natural airhead and always makes everyone laugh.
examples.notes: {天然|てんねん}ボケ = unintentionally funny person

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧、{天然|てんねん}なのか⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧なのか⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I can't tell if that person is genuinely airheaded or doing it on purpose.

notes:
COMMON COMPOUND WORDS:
・{天然|てんねん}⟦{水|すい}→水：02258_mizu⟧ (natural water)
・⟦{天然|てんねん}{記念物|きねんぶつ}→天然記念物：04899_tennenkinenbutsu⟧ (natural monument, protected species)
・{天然|てんねん}⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧ (natural resources)
・{天然|てんねん}⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧ (natural materials)
・{天然|てんねん}⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧ (natural gas)
・{天然|てんねん}⟦パーマ→パーマ：28205_paama⟧ (naturally curly hair)

COLLOQUIAL USAGE:
{天然|てんねん} alone can mean "airhead" or a person who is naturally scatterbrained in an endearing way. This is different from {天然|てんねん}⟦ボケ→ボケ：08822_boke⟧, which specifically means someone who unintentionally says funny things.

ANTONYM:
・⟦{人工|じんこう}→人工：11573_jinkou⟧ (artificial, man-made)
